definitions.gloss: to complain; to grumble; to find fault
definitions.explanation: To express dissatisfaction or objection about something, often repeatedly or in a nagging manner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧な。
⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{文句|もんく}を{言|い}われて⟦{傷|きず}ついた→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧。
examples.english: I was hurt when someone complained about my cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{文句|もんく}を{言|い}う⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{気|き}にしない→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: There are people who complain no matter what you do, so it's better not to worry about it.

notes:
One of the most common expressions for complaining in Japanese. ⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧ by itself can mean "complaint" or "objection," and {文句|もんく}を{言|い}う is the standard verb phrase.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to do nothing but complain
- {文句|もんく}を{言|い}われる: to be complained at (passive)
- ⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧なら⟦{言|い}え→言う：00515_iu⟧: if you have a complaint, say it
- ⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧なし: no complaints; perfect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}を{言|い}う→愚痴を言う：25447_guchiwoiu⟧/⟦{愚痴|ぐち}→愚痴：06623_guchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こぼす→こぼす：02104_kobosu⟧: to grumble, to vent — more about venting without expecting change
- ⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to express dissatisfaction — more formal
- ⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to make a formal complaint — stronger, more official
- ⟦ぶつぶつ→ぶつぶつ：05364_butsubutsu⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to mutter complaints — emphasizes the manner (muttering)

USAGE:
{文句|もんく}を{言|い}う often has a slightly negative connotation, suggesting the complaints are excessive or unreasonable. ⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧ is more neutral and implies a legitimate grievance.
